$comment: Cadastral parcel lists for places whose pliego delimits them parcel by parcel, copied from the pliego's delimited-area section. Polygons come from the Catastro's INSPIRE parcel service; built by Tools/data/build_parcels.py in GitHub Actions.

urbezo.source: Pliego de condiciones DOP Urbezo (PDO-ES-02585), text of Implementing Regulation (EU) 2024/2742, hosted by the Gobierno de Aragón (aragon.es), section 4, p. 4: polígono 35 of Cariñena, 51 parcels, 232.0214 ha
